title: Add line numbers to DSL parse errors and validation messages
description: Parse errors return messages like 'Expected ) to close node arguments. Found .' with no line number. read_file returns raw text without line numbers. The agent cannot locate errors in 100+ line DSL files. Need: (1) Track line numbers in PythonLexer tokens, (2) Include line numbers in PythonParser error messages, (3) Include line numbers in GraphValidator semantic errors, (4) Add line numbers to read_file output for text files.
definition-of-done: 1. PythonLexer Token class has int line field, tracked via newline counting. 2. PythonParser error messages prefixed with 'Line N:'. 3. ParsedNode has line field, GraphValidator errors prefixed with 'Line N:'. 4. read_file tool returns numbered lines for text files.
testing-plan: 1. Write DSL with deliberate syntax error on line 15. 2. validate_dsl should report 'Line 15: ...'. 3. Write DSL with unknown node type on line 10, validate should report 'Line 10: Unknown node type...'. 4. read_file on a .dsl file shows numbered lines.
